title: FDA Approval Letter: LUXTERA (miravimod) for Treatment of Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis
content:
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved LUXTERA (miravimod), a selective TYK2 inhibitor, for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.

APPROVAL DETAILS:
- Application Number: NDA 217845
- Applicant: Meridian Pharmaceuticals Inc.
- Approval Date: June 15, 2024
- Dosage Form: Oral tablet, 6 mg and 12 mg
- Recommended Dosage: 6 mg once daily; may increase to 12 mg once daily after 16 weeks if response is inadequate

CLINICAL EFFICACY:
Approval was based on two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials (CLARITY-1 and CLARITY-2) enrolling 1,842 adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
- PASI 75 response at Week 16: 67% (6 mg) vs 12% (placebo)
- PASI 90 response at Week 16: 41% (6 mg) vs 5% (placebo)
- IGA score of 0 or 1: 55% (6 mg) vs 9% (placebo)

SAFETY INFORMATION:
- Most common adverse reactions (≥5%): upper respiratory tract infection, headache, diarrhea, nausea
- Serious infections reported in 1.2% of patients vs 0.8% placebo
- Laboratory monitoring required: CBC and liver function tests at baseline, 4 weeks, and periodically thereafter

BOXED WARNING: None

RISK EVALUATION AND MITIGATION STRATEGY (REMS): Not required

PATENT EXPIRY: 2038 (composition of matter); 2041 (method of use)

For full prescribing information, visit www.fda.gov/drugs.
